messages.subject: Energy & Commodities Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Rademeyer,

Falcon Brook's executive-search focus across energy, commodities and the energy transition makes this a relevant introduction for senior international mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where energy and resources strategy, institutional relationships, regulatory execution and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
